description: This file is a shell script defining variables, functions, and procedures for backing up and managing log files in a software system, with conditional logic based on device type, support features, and environment variables.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file if it exists from source to destination.

methods.name: moveFiles
methods.description: Moves multiple files matching a pattern from one directory to another.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Performs backup of various log files based on source, destination, and operation.

methods.name: crashLogsBackup
methods.description: Backs up crash log files matching specific patterns.

methods.name: backupAppBackupLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up application backup log files, with conditional handling based on device type.

methods.name: backupSystemLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up system log files, with conditional handling based on device type.

methods.name: logCleanup
methods.description: Outputs a message indicating log backup completion.
